##Current shipping forecast##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Northwest 3 or 4 becoming variable 3 or less this afternoon, settling easterly 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, falling smooth or slight for a time.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Easterly 4 or 5, veering south or southeast 3 or 4 tomorrow evening, then south or southwest overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather##

Fair, rain later on Monday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain later.
